item.title: About
item.description:
I am an MSc student in Computer Science and Engineering at Daffodil International University, majoring in Data Science. My work focuses on applying deep learning and computer vision to real-world problems, especially medical imaging.

My research interests include Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Data Science, Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing, Cyber Security, Software Engineering, and Human-Computer Interaction.

  • Nationality: Bangladeshi
  • Location: Nishindara, Bogura
